cases.name: Crystal Dawn Hogue Martinez-Perez
cases.about: Crystal loved to dance. She celebrated her 37th birthday on Saturday at the Wild Horse Saloon. “She was my dancing partner,” Thomas-Peterson said. “She always lit up the room with her smile, but the last pictures I have of her, you can see the sadness in her face and eyes.
